rules.columns: Resolve row-1 canonical headers and documented aliases; reject duplicate canonical headers.
rules.day_header: Full date at midnight, valid hospital, day marker and empty CalendarEventId.
rules.route: The nearest valid preceding day header supplies date and hospital, independent of tab title.
rules.patient_hospital: Monthly patient hospital cells are optional manual content: new rows are blank; updates and moves preserve existing values and formulas. Never backfill them from a day header.
rules.identity: Whole-row moves preserve ScheduleSyncId and CalendarEventId. Duplicate or orphaned IDs and invalid day structure halt the workbook. An isolated patient binding conflict quarantines that row.
rules.fu: FU takes precedence over All. Undated FU has no event; clearing a bound date requires review.
rules.cancelled: Displayed MRN strikethrough, including rich text, keeps a grey event.
rules.delete: Two consecutive complete successful full reconciliations after disappearance; any failure or quarantined row disables deletion and resets confirmation; archived IDs protect events.
rules.calendar_writer: Only the designated external worker mutates Calendar.
rules.calendar_range: Scan complete supported monthly tabs and FU/All for identity safety. Reconcile current schedule dates today or later in Asia/Taipei, updating the same bound event when a past schedule returns to range. When a previously tracked today/future event is moved into the past, update that existing event once, verify it and persist completion; pending reconciliation survives failures and restarts. Confirmed past schedules then skip per-event Calendar requests. Never create a missing event for a past schedule. Preserve ScheduleSyncId and CalendarEventId. Missing-source past or undated events and archive identities remain protected from deletion.
rules.calendar_host: One registered host per spreadsheet and target calendar. Claim fixed DOCUMENT metadata ID atomically; include a machine-specific host fingerprint as well as worker and target IDs. A different host or copied database must stop, without automatic replacement.
rules.calendar_patient_binding: After verifying the stable schedule and event IDs, the Calendar worker accepts an equal normalized nonblank MRN or patient name from its trusted previous patient. A campus change may clear or replace the MRN while the name anchors the same patient; blank fields stay blank and are never filled from cache. If neither anchor matches, quarantine the row. Clinical main-program MRN identity checks remain strict.
rules.calendar_row_isolation: Invalid FU dates, cleared bound dates, patient binding conflicts and row-specific event validation failures quarantine only the affected rows. Healthy rows continue. Report sheet, one-based row and reason without clinical values; a partial cycle disables all deletions and resets missing-row confirmations. Structural ambiguity, host conflicts, archive locks and shared transport/authentication failures halt the workbook.
